One row was replaced. 'Türk mobil bankacılık uygulamaları (Artiwise analizi)' is not a single app, and no UI could be documented for it. It became Instagram: second most downloaded app worldwide in 2025 (762.3M, AppTweak) and 5th in the Türkiye App Store free list (DonanımHaber). Its 'why' cell says this. The Artiwise data still lives in R07-F15.

How the cells were filled: App Store listings came from the iTunes Search and Lookup API. I downloaded 3 screenshots per app, measured colors by pixel clustering and converted them with color.js to OKLCH, then read contact sheets and close crops of tab bars and controls. Each such cell cites the app's App Store page as a source. Written sources I opened: developer.apple.com/design/awards/2025 (Taobao, iA Writer, Mela, Opal, Feather, Speechify), Apple Newsroom iOS 26 design (2025-06-09), the Linear posts 'A Linear spin on Liquid Glass' (2025-10-21) and changelog 2026-01-22, the Airbnb press text via TechBuzz Ireland ('new 3D iconography'), the Fonts In Use Duolingo entry (Feather Bold and DIN Next Rounded), Instagram Visual Refresh (2022-05-23), iA's 2017 font article and ia.net/writer, and the Google Material 3 Expressive blog (2025-05-13).

Fact-check corrections now applied in the benchmark cells. Things 3: 'clean, crisp piece of paper' is credited to WIRED's David Pierce. Airbnb: the 3D icons now have a source. Tide Guide: the palette cell quotes 'aquatic theme, and sky-matching palette'. iOS 26 motion: buttons pulse when selected, tab bars wiggle, and the song title shimmers. Guitar Wiz: Increased Contrast and Differentiate Without Color are added.

Identity corrections. Taobao: the 2025 Interaction award was for its Apple Vision Pro app; the screenshots are from the iPhone app (cn store, Zhejiang Taobao Network).
